title: Compact Resize Image controls
summary: Resize from a compact anchored panel with clearer units, linked dimensions and visible planning labels.

Changed: Image > Resize Image and the dimensions strip open the same compact panel above the strip.
Right-aligned dimension fields, an aspect-lock icon and persistent Advanced expansion follow directly observed reference structure. Unfinished print settings retain red target labels.
Verified: Pixels and Percent, aspect lock, nested Escape, outside dismissal and Cancel preserve intended draft behavior.
Native percent Apply, Undo/Redo and save retain seven editable objects;144000 copied pixels match the shared renderer.
UI regression checks bounded anchoring and outside-click cancellation at two viewport sizes.

limitations: Print units, DPI metadata and resampling choices remain planned.
ClipCraft keeps resized objects editable; Snagit requires a flattening confirmation. That separate workflow is still planned.
Temporary status badges make the panel wider than the reference. Full pixel-level UI parity is not claimed.
